Complete SequentialPrimeSpecification retains arbitrary start, full multiplicities, nonempty proof and every member being1 or prime. rank is the sum, not a proved fiber dimension. PrimeEnumeration retains value, primality, strict monotonicity and exact Nat.nth canonical equation; the concrete canonicalPrimeEnumeration calls the original Mathlib infinitude/nth witnesses, with all three exact projection/equality proofs.

cantorPair is the displayed triangular-number formula; finiteSequenceCode is the exact empty0 and head1+pair recursion, and specificationCode uses start plus that list code. This source does not prove these formulas injective or equal to Mathlib Nat.pair. Do not import later SequentialPrime context proofs merely because they were read.

FiberCoordinate retains both lists, length equality and every Fin-index bound with the exact cast. mixedRadixValues preserves both empty-list zero clauses and least-significant-first recurrence. No nonempty/positive radix premise, automatic inverse or cardinality-only certification is added.

RawCarrierAddress retains all three Nat fields and DecidableEq/Repr. rawAddressCode uses the displayed cantorPair, while rawAddressEquivNat is separately constructed from Mathlib Nat.pair/unpair with both exact inverses. The complete AddressEnumeration requires Nat≃Address, code, injectivity and order iff.
